entities.name: PMID:25436452
observations: 2014 PLOS ONE study reports resveratrol amplified palmitate toxicity and cell death in several cancer cell lines, with increased XBP1 splicing, CHOP expression, and caspase-3 cleavage.

entities.name: Resveratrol
observations: In cancer cells exposed to palmitate, resveratrol increased toxicity and cell death and enhanced XBP1 splicing and CHOP expression (PMID:25436452).

entities.name: Palmitate
observations: Palmitate-induced toxicity/cell death in cancer cells was amplified by resveratrol; reported with increased XBP1 splicing and CHOP expression (PMID:25436452).

entities.name: Palmitate-resveratrol lipoapoptosis
observations: In several cancer cell lines, resveratrol amplified palmitate toxicity and cell death; increased XBP1 splicing and CHOP expression occurred alongside caspase-3 cleavage, consistent with ER-stress-associated apoptosis (PMID:25436452). The PubMed abstract provides no cell-line identities or effect sizes.
